description: This file defines the UsersController class responsible for handling user-related actions in a SuiteCRM-based project. It includes methods for resetting preferences, deleting users, editing user details, and saving user preferences, as well as handling view routing.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: Controller class managing user-related operations such as preference reset, deletion, editing, and saving within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: action_resetPreferences
methods.description: Resets the preferences of a user when triggered, typically via a user interface action.

methods.name: currentUserEqualsRecordUser
methods.description: Checks if the currently logged-in user matches the user record specified in the request.

methods.name: action_delete
methods.description: Performs user deletion or deactivation depending on permissions.

methods.name: action_wizard
methods.description: Sets the view to the user setup wizard.

methods.name: action_saveuserwizard
methods.description: Saves user details and preferences collected from the wizard interface.

methods.name: action_saveftsmodules
methods.description: Stores full-text search module preferences for the current user.

methods.name: action_editview
methods.description: Prepares the edit view for user data, with access control.

methods.name: action_detailview
methods.description: Prepares the detail view for user data, with access control.
